570843135.accepts_evidence: One open grant cycle a year: applicants send a short inquiry form, and those asked to continue receive the full application. The Grantmaking page currently says inquiries and applications are not being accepted and to check back for the next cycle dates. https://maryblackfoundation.org/grantmaking/
570843135.contact: Amy Page, community impact team; apage@maryblackfoundation.org; (864) 398-4274
570843135.deadlines: One cycle per year; no dates posted for the next cycle. Currently closed. Review takes about 105 days.
570843135.eligibility: Current 501(c)(3) nonprofits and governmental agencies serving Spartanburg County. One application per organization per cycle. Individual schools are steered to their district superintendent. Child care programs must be state licensed or registered and take part in the named quality programs.
570843135.geographic_limits: Spartanburg County, South Carolina. Organizations based elsewhere may apply only if the project mainly benefits Spartanburg County residents; a consultation is suggested first.
570843135.grant_range_stated: Typical awards $20,000 to $175,000, depending on scope and impact.
570843135.how_to_apply: When the cycle opens, submit the short inquiry form; if invited, complete the full application in the foundation's online system. Consultations are available once the application link is received and are recommended for first-time applicants.
570843135.name: Mary Black Foundation Inc
570843135.not_funded: Discriminatory activities or organizations with discriminatory policies. No other exclusions listed on the pages read.
570843135.notes: Strictly Spartanburg County, SC. The older Before You Apply page describes a direct written application with an optional consultation; the newer Grantmaking page describes the inquiry-form-first process, which is taken here as current. Separate eligibility and sponsorship pages exist and were not read.
570843135.page_dated: Grantmaking page modified 2026-11-06; FAQ modified 2026-09-22; Before You Apply modified April 8, 2024; 2026 grants listed.

570843135.types_of_support: General operating, program and project (including pilots), capacity building, multi-year; limited event and conference sponsorships under separate guidelines.
